$comment: How much one page may cost (docs/21-performance-and-coverage.md, section 3; backend/server/perf.py). reader_calls: the ladder's reader calls on a page are at most its lines times the rungs on its ladder. model_calls: one batched call per rung per page. decoded_megapixels: the upload limit (computer_vision.MAX_DECODE_PIXELS). recovery_reader_calls: line_recovery.MAX_READS times ROUNDS. cpu_ms: each stage's CPU time on one page, in milliseconds, five times the slowest benchmark page on GitHub's runners, at least 100 (CI run 39424319360; scripts/perf_budgets.py prints the table). In CI a benchmark page over a budget fails; in production a breach is counted in /health, never refused.
